biography.plain_text: Benjamin Meaker was a British businessman who developed the Meakers menswear chain with his brother Edgar. Raised in a Somerset farming family, he trained in carpentry and cabinetmaking before moving into retail. Their shops expanded across southern England and Wales, and he continued the business after his brother's death, later settling in Jersey.

long_biography.plain_text:
Benjamin Meaker's business fortune left a lasting place in academic life. A bequest from his estate established a research programme at the University of Bristol in 1976. Over subsequent decades, awards bearing his name brought overseas scholars to work with Bristol colleagues, developing research partnerships across disciplines.

The charitable funds associated with him also reached beyond universities. His Jersey trust supported the island's arts centre, whose theatre bears his name. In Australia, the trust's trustees provided substantial funding for research into Raine Island's environment. The funds supported the Raine Island Corporation's research into the island and protection of its environment.
